title: Homeowner Chooses Byrna to Keep Nap from Becoming a Nightmare
summary: Learn how an Indiana homeowner used his Byrna launcher during a home intrusion, highlighting the value of less-lethal self-defense and home protection.
body_markdown:
## Indiana Homeowner Shares How His Byrna Helped During a Home Intrusion


A home intrusion can happen without warning, making preparation and[having appropriate self-defense options readily available](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) an important part of personal safety. For one Indiana homeowner, a nighttime encounter with an unexpected intruder reinforced the value of having a Byrna launcher accessible at home.


The homeowner, a 52-year-old Indiana resident and former Air Force servicemember, had owned his home for more than a year when an unusual noise interrupted a nap in his recliner. Around 3:15 a.m., an intruder suddenly came through the front door.


With the situation unfolding quickly, the homeowner reached for his Byrna and fired a single round. The intruder fell backward outside the doorway, and police and emergency responders arrived shortly afterward.


When officers asked what had been used during the encounter, the homeowner showed them his Byrna launcher. One of the responding officers reportedly recognized the product and mentioned that he had purchased a Byrna for his wife.


### Choosing a Less-Lethal Self-Defense Option


The homeowner explained that he had considered several options before discovering Byrna. The compact design and his ability to use the launcher without the same concerns associated with a firearm were important factors in his decision.


He also described keeping both his Byrna and a firearm accessible in his living room. For him, the Byrna represents an option that can be considered before resorting to a firearm, depending on the circumstances.


That distinction can be an important part of a broader home-defense strategy. Different situations can require different responses, and having multiple options may provide greater flexibility when facing an evolving threat.


### Preparedness Starts Before an Emergency


The encounter also highlights why accessibility, familiarity, and preparation matter. A self-defense tool is only useful if it can be accessed when needed and the owner understands how it operates.


For homeowners considering additional protection, a Byrna launcher can provide a less-lethal option to incorporate into a broader personal safety plan. Training, responsible storage, and understanding applicable laws are all essential components of responsible ownership.
